# Prezidan Pa M — design system

A premium, mobile-first civic site where Haitians choose the president they want, starting from what they want changed in the country. Specific to Haiti, not a template. Default language Haitian Kreyòl.

## Palette (light)
- Night indigo #0B1230 — header, hero background, footer.
- Ultramarine #1A3BB5 — primary: selected priority tiles, primary buttons, links, progress bars, rank badges.
- Flag red #D41E3C — ONLY for the Vote action button. Never for anything else.
- Cool white #F3F5FA — page background.
- White #FFFFFF — cards.
- Ink #0B1A4A — body text and headings on light surfaces.
- Muted ink #5B6480 — secondary text.
- Hairline #E1E5F0 — card borders, dividers.

## Palette (dark, prefers-color-scheme)
- Background #070B1F, cards #0F1636, text #EAF0FF, muted #9AA6C8, hairline #22305E, ultramarine lifted to #5B7CFF for text/links, flag red stays #D41E3C.

## Typography
- One typeface only: Bricolage Grotesque (optical sizing on). System-ui fallback.
- Hero headline: big, confident, tight leading, weight 800, in Kreyòl: « Kisa w ta vle chanje an Ayiti? »
- Sentence case everywhere. No all-caps labels, no letter-spaced small caps.

## Shape & motion
- Radius 12px on tiles and cards, 999px on pills and the vote button.
- Soft single shadow on cards (0 1px 2px rgba(11,26,74,.06)). No glassmorphism, no gradients except a subtle indigo-to-ultramarine wash in the hero.
- One orchestrated reveal on load (staggered fade-up of hero then tiles). After that, motion only on user actions (tile select, sheet open, bar growth). Respect prefers-reduced-motion.
- No hover effects on everything; hover only on buttons and tiles.

## Signature component: the priorities grid
- 12 large tactile tiles in a 2-column grid on mobile (3 on tablet, 4 on desktop), min height 112px, thumb-size.
- Each tile: a simple 24px line icon (1.75px stroke) top-left, the label bottom-left, sentence case.
- Unselected: white card, hairline border, ink text, ultramarine icon.
- Selected: fills ultramarine #1A3BB5, white text and icon, and shows a 24px circular rank badge « 1 » « 2 » « 3 » top-right (white badge, ultramarine numeral) matching the order tapped.
- Max 3 selections; the fourth tap gently shakes nothing — tiles beyond 3 are simply dimmed to 60% until one is deselected.

## Candidates — neutrality rules (non-negotiable)
- Every candidate card has the identical format and size. Random order on every load.
- Avatar: 44px monogram circle in a shared blue/indigo hue range (never party colors). If a photo is used, it is the same size and crop for everyone, grayscale-tinted indigo duotone, no party logos.
- Match shown as « 2 of your 3 priorities » with a small ultramarine bar. Candidates without a published platform go in a second section titled « Platform not yet published ».
- A visible note: the ranking is not a recommendation; the vote is a people's vote, not a scientific poll.

## Layout
- Mobile-first, 16px side gutters, max content width 720px on desktop centered, 44px minimum touch targets.
- Header: night indigo bar, wordmark « Prezidan Pa M » left, language switch pill (KR · FR · EN) right.
- Sticky bottom action bar (white, hairline top, safe-area padding) appears after the first pick: shows the picks count and a primary ultramarine button « Wè kandida yo ».
- Profile opens as a bottom sheet/dialog with a drag handle.
- Visible focus rings: 2px ultramarine outline, 2px offset.

## Avoid
- Cream/terracotta AI-template look, all-caps labels, numbered markers where there is no sequence, generic SaaS card kits, hover effects on everything, stock illustrations, flags or party colors on candidates.
